literal: An edict abolished licentious sacrifices and burned miscellaneous gods.
idiomatic: An edict abolished licentious sacrifices and burned miscellaneous gods.

literal: That year the king of Goryeo, Yun, died; his heir An was made king of that state.
idiomatic: That year the king of Goryeo, Yun, died; his heir An was made king of that state.

literal: First month of spring in the first year of Zhenguang, day yiyou: an edict said, "Founding the state and binding the people—establishing teaching is the root; honoring teachers and exalting the Way is the canon from of old.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Zhenguang, on the yiyou day, an edict said, "Founding the state and binding the people—establishing teaching is the root; honoring teachers and exalting the Way is the canon from of old.

literal: Next year in mid-yang the season is harmonious and qi moist; offering sacrifice to Confucius and Yan Hui—that is the time.
idiomatic: Next year in mid-yang the season is harmonious and qi moist; offering sacrifice to Confucius and Yan Hui—that is the time.

literal: The relevant offices should beforehand repair the National University, depict and adorn the sages, appoint officers and select victims, choose an auspicious day and prepare the rites."
idiomatic: The relevant offices should beforehand repair the National University, depict and adorn the sages, appoint officers and select victims, choose an auspicious day and prepare the rites."

literal: Fourth month of summer, day bingchen: an edict ordered Minister Changsun Zhi to tour the northern frontier and observe customs.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingchen day, an edict ordered Changsun Zhi, minister, to tour the northern frontier and observe customs.

literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: an edict said, "We, slight and few, have received the precious chart; though we have not yet sought robes at dawn, we are wary and fearful all day; yet dimness and many faults remain; heat and drought are calamities; the blame rests on us and we cannot forget it even in sleep and eating.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, an edict said, "We, slight and few, have received the precious chart; though we have not yet sought robes at dawn, we are wary and fearful all day; yet dimness and many faults remain; heat and drought are calamities; the blame rests on us and we cannot forget it even in sleep and eating.

literal: Now criminal cases are numerous and the prisons still hold many; benevolence and kindness should be spread to aid these people.
idiomatic: Now criminal cases are numerous and the prisons still hold many; benevolence and kindness should be spread to aid these people.

literal: The Eight Seats should examine and try visible prisoners and strive to declare wrongful excess."
idiomatic: The Eight Seats should examine and try visible prisoners and strive to declare wrongful excess."

literal: Day guiwei: an edict said, "Warding off calamity and summoning response—repairing government is the root; the people are the spirits' master and should truly take the lead.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day an edict said, "Warding off calamity and summoning response—repairing government is the root; the people are the spirits' master and should truly take the lead.

literal: Inspectors and prefects share in governing the realm with us; they should pity and not rejoice, viewing the people as if wounded.
idiomatic: Inspectors and prefects share in governing the realm with us; they should pity and not rejoice, viewing the people as if wounded.

literal: Moreover heat and drought have lasted through the seasons and the myriad things are withered and worn—yet they do not comfort the poor and wronged or decide the multitude of lawsuits.
idiomatic: Moreover heat and drought have lasted through the seasons and the myriad things are withered and worn—yet they do not comfort the poor and wronged or decide the multitude of lawsuits.

literal: Let orders be sternly sent to provinces and commanderies to soothe and shelter well, striving for full discernment and adding reverence, so that affairs accord between men and spirits and timely spiritual response is achieved.
idiomatic: Let orders be sternly sent to provinces and commanderies to soothe and shelter well, striving for full discernment and adding reverence, so that affairs accord between men and spirits and timely spiritual response is achieved.

literal: Where tax and corvée are inconvenient for the people, list them in full by memorial and they will at once be remitted and abolished."
idiomatic: Where tax and corvée are inconvenient for the people, list them in full by memorial and they will at once be remitted and abolished."

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day bingzi: Attendant at the Secretariat Yuan Cha and Palace Attendant Liu Teng escorted the emperor to the front hall, [4] and forged an edict of the empress dowager saying, "Wei has possessed the realm; generation after generation its light has been renewed.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingzi day, Yuan Cha, attendant at the secretariat, and Liu Teng, palace attendant, escorted the emperor to the front hall, [4] and forged an edict of Empress Dowager Hu saying, "Wei has possessed the realm; generation after generation its light has been renewed.

literal: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, with heroic sagacity ruled Heaven and moved the capital to fix the tripod.
idiomatic: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, with heroic sagacity ruled Heaven and moved the capital to fix the tripod.

literal: Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu, with keen brilliance inherited the enterprise and pacified the realm; yet his great merit was not half done when he early ascended afar.
idiomatic: Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu, with keen brilliance inherited the enterprise and pacified the realm; yet his great merit was not half done when he early ascended afar.

literal: Thus chariots and writing were not yet uniform and whale-bandits still blazed.
idiomatic: Thus chariots and writing were not yet uniform and whale-bandits still blazed.

literal: The young lord is tender and weak; from childhood he has inherited the precious calendar; the altars of the lineage could not be reverently upheld—therefore we respectfully followed the multitude's request and held court to govern all affairs.
idiomatic: The young lord is tender and weak; from childhood he has inherited the precious calendar; the altars of the lineage could not be reverently upheld—therefore we respectfully followed the multitude's request and held court to govern all affairs.

literal: The emperor's years are already long; for long he has wished to withdraw; therefore last year, earnestly and repeatedly, we fully stated our intent; civil and military officials, inner and outer, have all understood this wish.
idiomatic: The emperor's years are already long; for long he has wished to withdraw; therefore last year, earnestly and repeatedly, we fully stated our intent; civil and military officials, inner and outer, have all understood this wish.

literal: Yet the unanimous will of all pressed us; we were painfully compelled to accept; we bent our efforts to the task until now.
idiomatic: Yet the unanimous will of all pressed us; we were painfully compelled to accept; we bent our efforts to the task until now.

literal: From this spring illness has repeatedly flared; medicines and stones could not cure it well; from early summer until now attacks have grown more severe; we can no longer daily order the myriad affairs or oversee great and small together.
idiomatic: From this spring illness has repeatedly flared; medicines and stones could not cure it well; from early summer until now attacks have grown more severe; we can no longer daily order the myriad affairs or oversee great and small together.

literal: The emperor's teeth have passed a full cycle of stars; his knowledge and learning have daily advanced; month by month he grows; the Way of the ruler flourishes—he is fully able to soothe and govern the myriad states and harmoniously decide the hundred duties.
idiomatic: The emperor's teeth have passed a full cycle of stars; his knowledge and learning have daily advanced; month by month he grows; the Way of the ruler flourishes—he is fully able to soothe and govern the myriad states and harmoniously decide the hundred duties.

literal: We shall lead the former intent and respectfully yield to a separate palace; far considering the meaning of restoring the son and illumining the regent, we shall nurture ourselves thereby; we truly hope that the lords and the black-haired masses will deeply reflect on this principle.
idiomatic: We shall lead the former intent and respectfully yield to a separate palace; far considering the meaning of restoring the son and illumining the regent, we shall nurture ourselves thereby; we truly hope that the lords and the black-haired masses will deeply reflect on this principle.

literal: If so, then above and below will be blessed and fine, heaven and earth clear and tranquil; Wei's Way will flourish and men and spirits rejoice—is this not good?"
idiomatic: If so, then above and below will be blessed and fine, heaven and earth clear and tranquil; Wei's Way will flourish and men and spirits rejoice—is this not good?"

literal: Thereupon Empress Dowager Hu was confined in the Northern Palace; Grand Tutor, Grand Minister, Prince of Qinghe Yi was killed; they took command of the forbidden guard and decided affairs in the palace hall.
idiomatic: Thereupon Empress Dowager Hu was confined in the Northern Palace; Yi, grand tutor, grand minister, and Prince of Qinghe, was killed; they took command of the forbidden guard and decided affairs in the palace hall.

literal: Day xinmao: the emperor performed the capping rite; a general amnesty; the reign title was changed; civil and military officials within and without were promoted one rank.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day the emperor performed the capping rite; a general amnesty was proclaimed; the reign title was changed; civil and military officials within and without were promoted one rank.

literal: Eighth month, day jiayin: Inspector of Xiangzhou, Prince of Zhongshan Xi raised troops intending to execute Cha and Teng; he did not succeed and was killed.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiayin day, Xi, inspector of Xiangzhou and Prince of Zhongshan, raised troops intending to execute Cha and Teng; he did not succeed and was killed.

literal: Ninth month, day renchen: the lord of Rouran, Anagui, came as a fugitive.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renchen day, the lord of Rouran, Anagui, came as a fugitive.

literal: Day wuxu: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Gaoyang Yong was made Chancellor and granted rear guard of feather canopy, drums and pipes, and forty guards with ceremonial swords.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day Yong, grand preceptor and Prince of Gaoyang, was made chancellor and granted rear guard of feather canopy, drums and pipes, and forty guards with ceremonial swords.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day yimao, [5] Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, Prince of Runan Yue was made Grand Minister.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yimao day, [5] Yue, grand general of agile cavalry, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Prince of Runan, was made grand minister.

literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: an edict said, "Rouran for generations was hero of the northern frontier and held sole sway over the desert marches; neighboring our upper state for more than a hundred years.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jihai day, an edict said, "Rouran for generations was hero of the northern frontier and held sole sway over the desert marches; neighboring our upper state for more than a hundred years.

literal: Since the divine tripod moved south, many years have passed; though tribute was sometimes absent, the border beacons were quiet; they leaned their hearts toward our capital and their secret sincerity grew purer.
idiomatic: Since the divine tripod moved south, many years have passed; though tribute was sometimes absent, the border beacons were quiet; they leaned their hearts toward our capital and their secret sincerity grew purer.

literal: Now their lord Anagui, parted by the hardships of the time, his state divided and kin scattered, galloped ten thousand li and sought refuge under the Way.
idiomatic: Now their lord Anagui, parted by the hardships of the time, his state divided and kin scattered, galloped ten thousand li and sought refuge under the Way.

literal: His grief matches Shen Baoxu and Wu Zixu; his loyalty and filial piety are fully worthy of pity.
idiomatic: His grief matches Shen Baoxu and Wu Zixu; his loyalty and filial piety are fully worthy of pity.

literal: We should for the time being treat him with guest rites and expect merit; enfeoff him with territory and open the great rivers and mountains—he may be enfeoffed as Duke of a Commandery of Shuofang, state founding, King of Rouran, with a fief of a thousand households, granted robes and crown, and given a light carriage; salary and guards like a kin prince."
idiomatic: We should for the time being treat him with guest rites and expect merit; enfeoff him with territory and open the great rivers and mountains—he may be enfeoffed as Duke of a Commandery of Shuofang, state founding, King of Rouran, with a fief of a thousand households, granted robes and crown, and given a light carriage; salary and guards like a kin prince."

literal: Twelfth month, day renzi: an edict said, "The King of Rouran, Anagui, having met with bandit calamity, came from afar to seek refuge; his state divided and his followers scattered, he still had no fixed lord; yet he ever cherished the northern wind and thought to return and gather his people.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renzi day, an edict said, "The King of Rouran, Anagui, having met with bandit calamity, came from afar to seek refuge; his state divided and his followers scattered, he still had no fixed lord; yet he ever cherished the northern wind and thought to return and gather his people.

literal: His petition stated his intent earnestly; we are deeply moved.
idiomatic: His petition stated his intent earnestly; we are deeply moved.

literal: Succoring the perishing and comforting the defeated is the common canon from of old.
idiomatic: Succoring the perishing and comforting the defeated is the common canon from of old.

literal: Envoys of the state may be sent, together with three envoys before and after him, to accompany Anagui;
idiomatic: Envoys of the state may be sent, together with three envoys before and after him, to accompany Anagui;

literal: and the Area Commander of Huaishuo is also ordered to select two thousand elite horsemen, personally lead and escort them to the border head, and observe the moment to summon and receive them.
idiomatic: and the area commander of Huaishuo is also ordered to select two thousand elite horsemen, personally lead and escort them to the border head, and observe the moment to summon and receive them.

literal: If they there welcome him, baskets of silks, carriages, horses, and the like should be granted, striving for generous elevation, and with ceremony send him off to return;
idiomatic: If they there welcome him, baskets of silks, carriages, horses, and the like should be granted, striving for generous elevation, and with ceremony send him off to return;

literal: if they will not receive him, let him return to court as he sees fit.
idiomatic: if they will not receive him, let him return to court as he sees fit.

literal: His travel gear and dispatch funds shall be measured and given by the Secretariat."
idiomatic: His travel gear and dispatch funds shall be measured and given by the Secretariat."

literal: Day xinyou: Minister of Works, Prince of Jingzhao Ji was made Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day Ji, minister of works and Prince of Jingzhao, was made minister over the masses.

literal: First month of spring in the second year: South Qinzhou Di rebelled.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year the Di of South Qinzhou rebelled.

literal: Second month, day gengxu: Acting Honorable Grand Master Bing Qiu was made General Who Pacifies the Army to attack them.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengxu day, Bing Qiu, acting honorable grand master, was made general who pacifies the army to attack them.

literal: Day guihai: the imperial carriage visited the National University and lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.
idiomatic: On the guihai day the imperial carriage visited the National University and lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.

literal: Third month, day gengwu: the emperor visited the National University to sacrifice to Confucius, with Yan Hui as secondary.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengwu day, the emperor visited the National University to sacrifice to Confucius, with Yan Hui as secondary.

literal: Day jiawu: Right Guard General Xi Kangsheng was about to kill Yuan Cha within the forbidden inner quarters; he did not succeed and was killed by Cha through a forged edict.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day Xi Kangsheng, right guard general, was about to kill Yuan Cha within the forbidden inner quarters; he did not succeed and was killed by Cha through a forged edict.

literal: Liu Teng, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: Liu Teng, equal in rank with the three excellencies, was made minister of works.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day gengzi: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Jingzhao Ji was promoted to Grand Guardian.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi day, Ji, minister over the masses and Prince of Jingzhao, was promoted to grand guardian.

literal: Day renyin: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies Cui Guang was made Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: On the renyin day Cui Guang, grand general of chariots and cavalry and equal in rank with the three excellencies, was made minister over the masses.

literal: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Yizhou Wen Sengming led his followers inward in submission.
idiomatic: Wen Sengming, Xiao Yan's inspector of Yizhou, led his followers inward in submission.

literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: Inspector of South Jingzhou Huan Shuxing rebelled south from Anchang.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, Huan Shuxing, inspector of South Jingzhou, rebelled south from Anchang.

literal: Day yiyou: Wuchang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day Wuchang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Intercalary month, day dingsi: Jumi and Persia both sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the dingsi day, Jumi and Persia both sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Sixth month, day jisi: Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jisi day, Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day guisi: Wuji sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the guisi day Wuji sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day guichou: an edict said, "The seasonal rains have not descended; grain and crops are damaged in form; the blame rests on us; morning and evening we are shaken with fear; though we have personally restrained and reduced offerings, still there is no response summoned.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou day, an edict said, "The seasonal rains have not descended; grain and crops are damaged in form; the blame rests on us; morning and evening we are shaken with fear; though we have personally restrained and reduced offerings, still there is no response summoned.

literal: The relevant offices should examine and follow the old canon and reverently carry out six measures: wrongful detention in prisons—quickly try and decide;
idiomatic: The relevant offices should examine and follow the old canon and reverently carry out six measures: wrongful detention in prisons—quickly try and decide;

literal: common officials neglecting duty—according to measure add correction and discipline;
idiomatic: common officials neglecting duty—according to measure add correction and discipline;

literal: widowers and the solitary in distress—wherever they are, preserve and comfort;
idiomatic: widowers and the solitary in distress—wherever they are, preserve and comfort;

literal: corvée and tax that trouble the people—all add remission and reduction;
idiomatic: corvée and tax that trouble the people—all add remission and reduction;

literal: the worthy and good, forthright and upright—promote in timely fashion; the greedy, cruel, wicked, and flatterers—at once remove and dismiss;
idiomatic: the worthy and good, forthright and upright—promote in timely fashion; the greedy, cruel, wicked, and flatterers—at once remove and dismiss;

literal: men and women long parted in resentment—strive to have them paired.
idiomatic: men and women long parted in resentment—strive to have them paired.

literal: May reform stop what violates and calamity be quelled."
idiomatic: May reform stop what violates and calamity be quelled."

literal: Eighth month, day jisi: Fulu sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jisi day, Fulu sent envoys with tribute.

literal: The latter lord of Rouran, Yujiulü Hounifa, came as a fugitive to Huaishuo garrison.
idiomatic: The latter lord of Rouran, Yujiulü Hounifa, came as a fugitive to Huaishuo garrison.

literal: The text is deficient.
idiomatic: The text is deficient.

literal: First month of spring in the third year, day xinhai: the emperor plowed the sacred field.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year, on the xinhai day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day gengchen: the lord of Gaoche, Fuluo Yifu, was made General Who Pacifies the West, Duke of Xihai Commandery, state founding, and King of Gaoche.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengchen day, Fuluo Yifu, lord of Gaoche, was made general who pacifies the west, Duke of Xihai commandery, state founding, and King of Gaoche.

literal: Sixth month, day jisi: an edict said, "We, young and dim, from childhood have inherited the precious calendar; we have not been able to reverently serve the upper spirits or move and extend harmonious qi; therefore heat and drought have come year after year; good rain has not soaked through; the hundred crops are scorched and withered; late plantings are not yet sown; a year of calamity is forming; the autumn harvest cannot be hoped for.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jisi day, an edict said, "We, young and dim, from childhood have inherited the precious calendar; we have not been able to reverently serve the upper spirits or move and extend harmonious qi; therefore heat and drought have come year after year; good rain has not soaked through; the hundred crops are scorched and withered; late plantings are not yet sown; a year of calamity is forming; the autumn harvest cannot be hoped for.

literal: The blame rests on us; we are anxious and fearful, shaken in heart.
idiomatic: The blame rests on us; we are anxious and fearful, shaken in heart.

literal: Now according to the old model commissioners may be sent separately to pray at the sacred mountains and rivers and all mountains and rivers and the hundred spirits able to raise clouds and rain; let them be utterly reverent so response must descend; jade and silk and victims and oxen, as each deserves, should be offered."
idiomatic: Now according to the old model commissioners may be sent separately to pray at the sacred mountains and rivers and all mountains and rivers and the hundred spirits able to raise clouds and rain; let them be utterly reverent so response must descend; jade and silk and victims and oxen, as each deserves, should be offered."

literal: Officials above and below should bend themselves in self-discipline, decide wrongful cases, halt earthworks, reduce meals and withdraw music, and forbid slaughter."
idiomatic: Officials above and below should bend themselves in self-discipline, decide wrongful cases, halt earthworks, reduce meals and withdraw music, and forbid slaughter."

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day renzi: Persia, Buhan, and Kucha all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renzi day, Persia, Buhan, and Kucha all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day jisi: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jisi day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eleventh month, day yisi: the imperial carriage performed rites at the Circular Mound.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yisi day, the imperial carriage performed rites at the Circular Mound.

literal: Day bingwu: an edict said, "Governing the calendar and clarifying the seasons is the illustrious track of former kings; examining the stars and correcting the pitch pipes is the common rule of successive ages.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day an edict said, "Governing the calendar and clarifying the seasons is the illustrious track of former kings; examining the stars and correcting the pitch pipes is the common rule of successive ages.

literal: Therefore the Northern Ping reform was fixed in Han times and Yang Wei drafted calculations in Wei days.
idiomatic: Therefore the Northern Ping reform was fixed in Han times and Yang Wei drafted calculations in Wei days.

literal: Since our imperial fortune was first founded, the canon and statutes were still lacking; advancing the gnomon and measuring the sun's shadow did not exhaust its principle.
idiomatic: Since our imperial fortune was first founded, the canon and statutes were still lacking; advancing the gnomon and measuring the sun's shadow did not exhaust its principle.

literal: Former courts for successive reigns each sighed at this.
idiomatic: Former courts for successive reigns each sighed at this.

literal: By the Shengui period Confucian officers were first ordered to reform and create, correcting errors, changing the cycle and altering the statute, [7] and for the first time the armillary sphere was aligned.
idiomatic: By the Shengui period Confucian officers were first ordered to reform and create, correcting errors, changing the cycle and altering the statute, [7] and for the first time the armillary sphere was aligned.

literal: Now the celestial standard begins anew; yang warmth is about to open; the myriad things first sprout—it is right to renew what eye and ear perceive; this is what is called Wei an old domain yet its calendar is made new.
idiomatic: Now the celestial standard begins anew; yang warmth is about to open; the myriad things first sprout—it is right to renew what eye and ear perceive; this is what is called Wei an old domain yet its calendar is made new.

literal: Let it now be proclaimed inner and outer and styled the Zhenguang calendar.
idiomatic: Let it now be proclaimed inner and outer and styled the Zhenguang calendar.

literal: Moreover at the first festival of the year we obtained the hill sacrifice at Qiu; spirits and men joined in harmony; principle met between hidden and manifest; we wish to renew this together with the hundred millions—a general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm."
idiomatic: Moreover at the first festival of the year we obtained the hill sacrifice at Qiu; spirits and men joined in harmony; principle met between hidden and manifest; we wish to renew this together with the hundred millions—a general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm."

literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: Left Honorable Grand Master Huangfu Du was given equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guiyou day, Huangfu Du, left honorable grand master, was given equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Day yiyou: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Right Vice Director Yuan Qin was given equal precedence with the Three Excellencies; Grand Guardian, Prince of Jingzhao Ji was made Grand Tutor; Minister over the Masses Cui Guang was made Grand Guardian.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yuan Qin, grand general of chariots and cavalry and right vice director, was given equal precedence with the three excellencies; Ji, grand guardian and Prince of Jingzhao, was made grand tutor; Cui Guang, minister over the masses, was made grand guardian.

literal: Day dinghai: because prefects and magistrates rashly erected steles and eulogies and readily raised temple towers;
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, because prefects and magistrates rashly erected steles and eulogies and readily raised temple towers;

literal: mansions were lavish and shops traded goods.
idiomatic: mansions were lavish and shops traded goods.

literal: An edict ordered the Censor-in-Chief to rectify and sternly awe conduct and impeach on the basis of present facts.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the censor-in-chief to rectify and sternly awe conduct and impeach on the basis of present facts.

literal: Seventh and sixth ranks—salary sufficient to replace farming—were also not permitted to monopolize and post shop signs or contend for profit in the cities.
idiomatic: Seventh and sixth ranks—salary sufficient to replace farming—were also not permitted to monopolize and post shop signs or contend for profit in the cities.

literal: Second month of spring in the fourth year, day renchen: the late Prince of Xianyang Xi was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fucheng; Prince of Jingzhao Yu as Prince of Lintao; Prince of Qinghe Yi as Prince of Fanyang; they were buried with enhanced rites.
idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the fourth year, on the renchen day, the late Xi, Prince of Xianyang, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fucheng; Yu, Prince of Jingzhao, as Prince of Lintao; Yi, Prince of Qinghe, as Prince of Fanyang; they were buried with enhanced rites.

literal: Day dingchou: Prince of Hejian Chen and Prince of Zhangwu Rong were both stripped of rank and name for corruption.
idiomatic: On the dingchou day Chen, Prince of Hejian, and Rong, Prince of Zhangwu, were both stripped of rank and name for corruption.

literal: Day jimao: because the lord of Rouran Anagui led his followers to raid the frontier, Left Assistant Director Yuan Fu, concurrently Minister, was made Northern Route Mobile Headquarters bearing credentials to instruct him.
idiomatic: On the jimao day, because the lord of Rouran Anagui led his followers to raid the frontier, Yuan Fu, left assistant director and concurrently minister, was made northern route mobile headquarters bearing credentials to instruct him.

literal: The latter lord of Rouran Hounifa came to court at the capital.
idiomatic: The latter lord of Rouran Hounifa came to court at the capital.

literal: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Minister of Works Liu Teng died.
idiomatic: Liu Teng, minister of works, died.

literal: Fourth month of summer: Anagui seized Yuan Fu and drove off livestock north in flight.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Anagui seized Yuan Fu and drove off livestock north in flight.
